title: Methods for testing black and white photographic enlargers
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the methods for testing black and white photographic enlargers for amateur and professional use in ordinary photographic practice.
clause_3_terminology: Methods for testing black and white photographic enlargers

electrical_and_safety_parameters: rated voltage ol' the enlarger. W
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
